description: Runs the toolchain's groot-finetune-pipeline SageMaker Pipeline: Train, then RegisterModel into the groot-models model package group. The production shape when a model-registry entry is wanted.
inputInstructions:
Select the asset holding a LeRobot v2 dataset (parquet episodes, mp4 videos and the meta/*.json files). The whole asset is staged to the toolchain's datasets bucket, validated, and the groot-finetune-pipeline is started. The checkpoint (model.tar.gz), the evaluation report and the registered ModelPackageArn are written back to this asset under a per-run folder.

The Hugging Face token is read from the toolchain account's Secrets Manager at submit time; it is never a form field.

tagSchema.label: Max training steps
tagSchema.description: Number of optimiser steps. The toolchain's smoke test uses 50; a real run uses 5000 or more.

tagSchema.label: Global batch size
tagSchema.description: Must be divisible by the GPU count of the chosen instance type.

tagSchema.label: Base model
tagSchema.description: Hugging Face model id the container fine-tunes from.

tagSchema.label: Training instance type
tagSchema.description: SageMaker training instance. Quota for the instance family must exist in the toolchain account.
